caption: The drawing shows a wooden rocking chair with a curved seat, tall spindled back, and armrests that curve outward. The chair is mostly dark brown with areas of lighter wood grain visible, and features decorative yellow and gold painted designs. The top rail of the backrest is rectangular with rounded ends, embellished with gold scrollwork, floral patterns, and small sunburst motifs. The arm supports and the back spindles are thin and evenly spaced. The seat has a scooped shape and additional yellow intaglio-style designs at the front. The legs are slender, rounded, and connected by stretchers, with more yellow-gold decorative motifs, tapering down to two curved rockers that allow the chair to rock back and forth. The bottom right of the image is signed with the name "Lawrence Hymn." The background is light with a few faint marks or stains and contains no additional objects or elements.
title: Hitchcock Rocker
